# Hedera by Example — full agent index
> Extended companion to https://hbe.expo.app/llms.txt. Prefer the MCP server for structured access.

Site: https://hbe.expo.app
Short index: https://hbe.expo.app/llms.txt
Repository: https://github.com/altaga/Hedera-By-Example
MCP endpoint: https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp
MCP manifest: https://hbe.expo.app/mcp/manifest.json
MCP tools: https://hbe.expo.app/mcp/tools.json
Well-known: https://hbe.expo.app/.well-known/mcp.json

## MCP server

Server name: `hedera-by-example-mcp` version `2.0.0`
Transport: Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC at `https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp`
Header: `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`
Protocols: 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05
Local stdio: `node mcp/index.js` (Node.js 20+; optional `--http 3001`)

### Tools

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| search_labs | Find the Hedera by Example labs that teach something (free text in English or Spanish, SDK class names, HIP/HCS numbers). Returns a ranked list with what each lab needs, its cost and a link; use get_lab for the code. |
| get_lab | Full lab: concept, what to run first, wallets it needs, approximate HBAR cost, official references and the complete runnable code. |
| list_labs | The course map: 16 modules and 131 labs with their slugs, optionally for one module. |
| query_curriculum | Search the labs and return the best matches with their full code (heavier than search_labs + get_lab). |
| anti_hallucination_rules | Verified rules that prevent the usual mistakes on Hedera: tinybar units, Hbar math, fees and gas, key types, EVM addresses, associations, size limits, Mirror Node lag. |
| architecture_decision_tree | When to use the Consensus Service, the Token Service or smart contracts, with the full guardrails guide. |
| mirror_node_query | Live read from the public Mirror Node (free): accounts, tokens, topics (with decoded messages), transactions, contracts, schedules, balances, exchange rate, gas prices, nodes, blocks. Upstream HTTP errors and timeouts return isError; follow links.next with the next argument. |
| estimate_cost | Price a set of Hedera operations in USD and in HBAR at the live exchange rate (and gas at the live gas price times the gas limit you give; without gas, contract totals are marked incomplete). |
| query_knowledge | Curated map of Hedera studios, SDKs, standards and solutions (AI agents, RWA/ATS, stablecoins, DePIN, identity, privacy) with official links. |
| official_resources | Official Hedera documentation, repositories and specifications. |

### Client config snippets

Remote URL (Cursor `.cursor/mcp.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "url": "https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Desktop (`mcp-remote`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Local stdio:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hedera-by-example": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/Hedera-By-Example/mcp/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
curl -sS -X POST 'https://hbe.expo.app/api/mcp' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"llms-full","version":"1.0"}}}'
```

## Course map (131 labs, en + es)

SDK: @hiero-ledger/sdk 2.90.1
Lab count: 131
